display.title: Episode 427: A Judge for a Day, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: Pirkei Avos teaches that Hashem creates the world from nothing every moment; two sisters lead the Shema; chapter 1 of 'A Judge for a Day'; and mitzvah time begins learning Havdalah.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi prepares for Shavuos with the Mishnah children will learn this Shabbos in the fifth chapter of Pirkei Avos: the world was created with ten sayings. A carpenter only shapes wood that already exists, but Hashem creates something from nothing and keeps creating the world every second, just as a light bulb shines only while the current flows. Realizing that our life comes from Hashem, we show our thanks through Torah, mitzvos and good midos. Two sisters from a Brooklyn girls' school lead the Shema, and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time begins 'A Judge for a Day': Leibel, a bright and kind yeshiva boy, hears that honest Berel the butcher has been accused by a sly tailor of stealing 365 gold coins, which the tailor found hidden under a loose floorboard in Berel's shop. Berel prays with his Tehillim, and Leibel asks Hashem to show him a way to help. In mitzvah time, Uncle Yossi starts teaching Havdalah: what it means, when to say it, and what goes in a Havdalah kit, with a Havdalah-candle quiz prize. The show ends with good news about a boy listeners prayed for, and Shabbos candle times.
display.lesson: Hashem creates the world from nothing at every moment, so we thank Him with Torah, mitzvos and good midos.

date.note: Estimate was 6 Iyar. Candles 7:51, Shabbos ends 9:01 fit Friday 18 May 1990; Pirkei Avos chapter 5 'this coming Shabbos' fits 19 May 1990.
